title: Deception Record
description: One claim-vs-reality data point for a (product, axis, sub_axis) tuple. Designed to be reproducible and falsifiable: every value carries ≥1 source with a verbatim quote.

sub_axis.description: snake_case sub-axis name, free-form within an axis

kind.description: numeric: quantifiable gap with absolute and pct. categorical: naming/classification mismatch. definitional: claimed vs. measured property are different things.

pct.description: (reality - claim) / claim × 100. Negative = reality below claim.

severity.description: Required for kind=categorical or kind=definitional. Optional for kind=numeric.

narrative_one_liner.description: ≤200 char tldr suitable for table views and consumer-facing one-liners. Factual, no editorial.

narrative.description: 2–4 sentence factual description suitable for the consumer surface. Describe the gap, do not editorialize.

methodology_notes.description: How was the reality measured? Test conditions, equipment, sample size.

caveats.description: Known limitations of this specific record: contaminated trim, paywalled source, single-unit test, etc.

alternative_explanations.description: What else could explain the gap? Honest framing for falsifiability.

n_independent_measurements.description: Number of independent (different organization) Tier-2 measurements supporting the reality value.

evidence_grade.description: Per METHODOLOGY.md §3. A: claim from Tier 1/4, reality from Tier 1 or ≥2 Tier 2 or 1 Tier 2 + Tier 3 N≥10. B: single Tier 2 or editorial framing. C: Tier 3 small N or older. D: Tier 4 only or anecdotal.

qualifier.description: Conditions or caveats, e.g. '70 mph steady, mild weather, no HVAC'
